hearing: Plan numbers are like ABC-123; "ABC one two three" is ABC-123.

asks._note: Optional. Both commands set turns on answer_ask. listCommand prints asks.json; answerCommand reads {"argv": ["board", "answered", ...]} as JSON on stdin and runs it. dryRun logs the write instead of running it.

memory._note: Optional. dir turns on call notes and recall; dejaCommand reads the query on stdin.

_note_preload: preload: read the needs queue, sessions, sources marked preload and recent call notes at call start (and offer catch_up). filler: say a short line when a tool starts in silence.
